## Welcome {#welcome}

The [U.S. Greenhouse Gas (GHG) Center](https://earth.gov/ghgcenter) provides a cloud-based system for exploring and analyzing U.S. government and other curated greenhouse gas datasets.

This site provides supplementary technical information about the US GHG Center including how to access data services, documentation for the US GHG Center JupyterHub, Jupyter notebook tutorials, and data stewardship documentation.


## Contents

1. **Data Services:** API documentation and instructions for accessing the US GHG Center [JupyterHub](services/jupyterhub.qmd) environment for interactive computing.
2. **Data Usage Notebooks:** Jupyter notebook tutorials which demonstrate how to access and visualize US GHG Center datasets, and more. 
3. **Data Transformation Notebooks:** Code used to process datasets for display in the US GHG Center.
4. **Processing and Verification Reports:** Reports that document how datasets were integrated into the US GHG Center. 
5. **Data Flow Diagrams:** Flowcharts that summarize how each dataset was integrated into the US GHG Center. 

## Contact

For technical help or general questions, please contact the US GHG Center Help Desk using the [feedback form](https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSeVWCrnca08Gt_qoWYjTo6gnj1BEGL4NCUC9VEiQnXA02gzVQ/viewform).
